cards.claim: Clément Rosset was selected to receive the Knight of the Legion of Honour.
cards.answer: Knight of the Legion of Honour
cards.quote: You've been selected to receive the Knight of the Legion of Honour, the highest distinction in France."

cards.claim: In 1978, Rosset was awarded the Roger Nimier Prix, a prestigious French literary award, for his novel "Le Réel et son double" (The Real and its Double).
